answer: Reaching the sparrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the zenith is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
